rules: Any liquid asset: stock, crypto, or leveraged/inverse ETF
Rotate each 6:30am CT run — sell yesterday, buy today's best
Leverage matched to conviction; asymmetric payoff preferred
Hard stop at entry; spot-crypto-only on weekends

positions.name: Bitcoin
positions.catalyst: Saturday Oct 17 — US equities closed, spot crypto only. BTC ~81.55k, flat vs 81.46k midnight open; ETH 2,436 (+0.5%), SOL 104.9 (flat), XRP/DOGE flat. Backdrop: CoinShares ~$434M weekly digital-asset fund outflows, ETH/SOL ETF outflows through October, hot 6.3% PPI weighing on risk.
positions.driver: Low-edge weekend: no fresh crypto catalyst, so park in the lowest-vol, deepest-liquidity spot asset rather than reach for higher-beta alts (SOL/ETH carry the heaviest ETF outflows). BTC was the relative leader on Friday flows. Unleveraged spot; standard 10% spot stop.
positions.risks: Continued fund outflows / macro risk-off from hot inflation prints; weekend thin-liquidity flush toward the high-70s; Robinhood market-maker spread is wide (~1.9% bid/ask) so real round-trip friction exceeds the paper mark. Stop 73,395.28 (-10%).
